reflect_en: The psalmist calls everyone God has rescued to speak up: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so. This Tuesday, don't keep His goodness to yourself; tell someone what He has brought you through.
q_en: What has God redeemed you from that you want to say out loud today?
x_en: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever. Let the redeemed of the LORD say so
tiktok: If He's brought you through, say so 🙏 Psalm 107:1–3 — His loving devotion endures forever
yt_title: Let the Redeemed of the LORD Say So | Psalm 107:1–3 #Shorts
yt_line: Tell someone what He has done for you today.
li_open: Teams grow stronger when good stories get told out loud.
li_quote: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever. Let the redeemed of the LORD say so
li_body: The psalmist doesn't let gratitude stay private; the redeemed are called to say so. In churches and teams, making room for people to share answered prayers and testimonies builds faith in everyone listening, and reminds us to keep praying for one another.
reflect_es: El salmista invita a todos los que Dios ha rescatado a contarlo: Díganlo los redimidos de Jehová. Este martes, no te guardes Su bondad; cuéntale a alguien de qué te ha sacado el Señor.
q_es: ¿De qué te ha redimido Dios que quieres contar hoy?
x_es: Alabad a Jehová, porque es bueno; porque para siempre es su misericordia. Díganlo los redimidos de Jehová
key_en: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so
